summary: Get Started now guides you through Azure resources and Workloads, and shows who needs which rights.

new.title: Get Started: Azure resources step
new.text: A new optional step shows the scopes PIM Manager manages and, per scope, the command that gives the engine User Access Administrator.

new.title: Get Started: Workloads step
new.text: A new optional step shows what is missing for Defender XDR, Intune and Power BI, with Confirm or Not used.

new.title: Who needs what table
new.text: Engine permissions opens with a table listing each identity by name and object id with its rights.

fixes.title: Clearer Settings
fixes.text: A category click goes to the top, the leftover card reads Remove access when its definition is deleted, and the Emergency override card explains itself and stays off until a passphrase is set.
